entries.positive_observation: The unchanged raw has the compact rounded yellow mascot identity, green-ringed solid black eyes without sclera, one restrained closed mouth, distinct dark brows and a smooth clean-shaven chin. The viewer-right three-quarter pose, olive peaked cap, glossy visor, gold piping and two separated front emblems remain recognizable. The field-grey uniform, light shirt edges, dark tie and two collar patches are retained; the collar makes natural contact around a short broad neck without a funnel neck, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The pale photographic backplate and complete tilted frame remain, and the cream note has two compact upper mark rows plus the source-visible small dark right-edge tab without a paperclip.
entries.alpha_decision: visible-alpha-v1: pass. Full raw, white/cyan composites and source/return alpha were viewed. The native RGBA exterior preserves the complete frame/note silhouette, including the small note tab, with no visible interior holes, smoke, garment transparency, lost photographic backing or working-matte halo. The measured internal 252-254 values and lack of 255 are retained and are not rejection grounds; no alpha repair is required.
visible_limitations: At 65x67, fine cap embroidery, collar-insignia motifs and note glyphs are unreadable; approval is limited to their actually visible shapes, placement and counts, not invented lettering or fine motifs.
Fine eye/temple and collar-throat source pixels are very small, but no clearly visible feature mismatch or collar defect remains.
